newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was active late Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed fully $1.00 higher.

Inquiry and demand were good. Sales confirmed on 17,000 slaughter steers and 14,800 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 108,200 head confirmed including 21,900 head or about 20 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 66.00, few pens including cutting bulls 65.00-66.00; pen select with end choice 65.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 980-1150 lbs 66.00, pen 65.00; few mixed commercial to choice 1050 lbs heifers and heiferettes 64.50.
week to date: 108200 last week: 115700 last year: 68900
